title: pvAMRConnectivity
body:
## pvAMRConnectivity

Fragment identification on non-overlapping AMR material data (such as CTH output from pvSpyPlotReader): for each selected volume-fraction cell array it labels connected regions of cells whose value exceeds VolumeFractionValue, including across block and level boundaries when ResolveBlocks is on, and adds a cell array RegionId-<array name>. The output is the same AMR data with these labels; pvAMRFragmentIntegration then sums fragment volumes and masses. Use pvAMRFragmentsFilter to run the whole chain in one step.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Unlike AMR Contour and AMR Dual Clip, this filter compares VolumeFractionValue with the stored array values without scaling by 255; with unsigned char fractions the default 0.1 therefore keeps any cell with a non-zero fraction.
- Without at least one SelectMaterialArrays entry no labels are produced.
- Overlapping AMR is rejected; the input must be vtkNonOverlappingAMR.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AMRConnectivity`. Identity: `filters/AMRConnectivity`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the volume input of the filter. Accepted data: non-overlapping AMR data (vtkNonOverlappingAMR). The input needs at least one cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkNonOverlappingAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PropagateGhosts` | Propagate regionIds into the ghosts. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ResolveBlocks` | Resolve the fragments between blocks. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SelectMaterialArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine fragments | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VolumeFractionValue` | This property specifies the values at which to compute the isosurface. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

```json
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAMRConnectivity",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
